## Lentera Worship v{{VERSION}}

### 🇬🇧 English

Presentation software for song lyrics, Bible verses, and worship slides. Free and open source.

**Install (Windows)**
1. Download `Lentera.Worship_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or the `.msi` from the Assets section below.
2. If you see a blue "Windows protected your PC" warning, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

> This warning appears because the app is not yet digitally signed (no paid certificate), not because it contains a virus. The full source code is available in this repository.

**SHA256 checksums**

{{CHECKSUMS}}

Verify in PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\<file-name> -Algorithm SHA256`

---

### 🇮🇩 Bahasa Indonesia

Aplikasi presentasi untuk lirik lagu, ayat Alkitab, dan slide ibadah. Gratis dan open source.

**Cara install (Windows)**
1. Unduh `Lentera.Worship_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe` (disarankan) atau file `.msi` dari bagian Assets di bawah.
2. Jika muncul peringatan biru "Windows protected your PC", klik **More info**, lalu **Run anyway**.

> Peringatan ini muncul karena aplikasi belum ditandatangani secara digital (belum memakai sertifikat berbayar), bukan karena ada virus. Seluruh kode sumber bisa diperiksa di repositori ini.

**Checksum SHA256**

{{CHECKSUMS}}

Verifikasi di PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\<nama-file> -Algorithm SHA256`
